headline: Nevish Line Flares and Moltworth Falls as Heavy Clashes Grip Northern Sectors
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, Nevish Line has erupted into sharp contention, logging nine strategic base events across the past two hours around Princefal and Tomb Father. In Viper Pit, an intensifying battle culminated in Moltworth being captured by Colonial forces following nearly one thousand casualties in the latest two-hour frame. High-tempo base exchanges continue across Fisherman's Row and Callahan's Passage, producing six and three transitions respectively in the recent window. Fighting across Stlican Shelf cooled slightly from earlier crests to a single base exchange, while Weathered Expanse suffered an accelerating bloodbath of over twenty-three hundred combined dead in two hours despite strategic lines temporarily holding firm. Mooring County generated three further exchanges near The Wind Hills, whereas central sectors including Dead Lands and Linn of Mercy have settled into a noticeable lull.
